Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) Amendment related to the drug vial for preservative-free ketamine has been reclassified from a Major Amendment to a Minor Amendment.
FDA has revised the Generic Drugs User Fee Act (GDUFA) Goal Date to November 10, 2026.
